title: Compare real EUR Party touch in Android host engines
platforms: Android engine interpreter on host Linux; native Android untested
changes: Document one reproducible EUR Party gallery where upstream selects the touched member and the fork confirms the previously selected member.
validation: Both isolated Android Engine::tap host interpreter tests pass at frame 3113; initial 240x160 framebuffer files match; ROM, source save and two input scripts retain pre-run hashes.
limitations: One EUR scene and 240x160 viewport; no pad comparison, complete state equivalence, native blocks, JNI, Android emulator or physical device. Offline builds emitted unused-code warnings; an initial exact-filter invocation ran zero tests and was corrected.
